items.title: 61529_Maxine Sullivan oral history interview
items.q: I got a call from some woman. Her name was Rosetta Reitz, I found out. She said there's a show going into rehearsal and there's a part in it for you.

ctx.x: I'm talking about on tape. That is something to come to yet.

Yeah. Well, I guess through the fact that I was doing "My Old Friends" two years ago. I got involved in this stage production. I got a call from some woman. Her name was Rosetta Reitz, I found out. She said there's a show going into rehearsal and there's a part in it for you. So she said if you're interested to call Phil Rose who was the Director.
